articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Nov. 3, 2026 result: John Messinger lost the race for Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 9 with 4,602,681 votes (47.7%); opponent: Holly Taylor (D) 5,043,094 (52.3%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
